scope: Six newly authored nonblind development scenarios in actual Pi Session/Controller. Paired v2/v3 comparison fixes main Agent, support judgment, rerank, applicability catalog, separated query and repairBudget1; v3 combines neutral question projection with one tool-free parser, so any difference is not isolated model effect or production/C1 admission. All 24 planned turns remain in the denominator, including failed/skipped predecessors.
syntheticBoundary: Every actor, order and inter-turn change is author-created synthetic data in isolated in-memory stores. No SQL, QQ, merchant, booking or payment write is performed. Order ownership, fresh reads, Controller scope/provenance and no-side-effect boundaries execute in actual code. The original eight online documents and declared-v2 SKU catalog are reused without edits. Two controlled state revisions correct synthetic product identity while retaining one explicit order and financial/coupon history; they are fixture corrections, not a merchant changing purchased terms or an Agent changing a package. Purchase-time SKU/rule snapshot contracts are not implemented; corrected dinner data retaining lunch settlement must not be used to infer prices/refunds. Unknown product-demo-3 keeps the lunch display name but has no declared category; name/user text cannot supply missing applicability. An ordinary nonholiday Saturday without events is a stated hypothetical, not live calendar, holiday or reception verification. No successful topic, clarification, focus, model answer or question decision is injected into real runs. Dependent turns require actual completed preceding source-bound topics or safe clarification; missing prerequisites remain not_run. Independent original-question phrasing is manually authored and reviewed before execution. The dataset is fixed, exposed, not blind and is never relabeled after observed model scores.
